description: SF-028 Greengrass compatibility matrix. Status values describe this repository at the commit containing this file, not merged-later or proposed work. See docs/GREENGRASS_COMPATIBILITY.md.

reference.greengrass: AWS IoT Greengrass V2 classic nucleus 2.x documentation; nucleus lite is out of scope

components.AWS-managed components: SF-038 catalog and adapter reference versions in managed-components.json

levels.functional: Equivalent behaviour through SuiFleet's own chain, recipe and local APIs.
levels.aws_api: Unmodified AWS IPC/SDK/CLI/cloud-API clients work against SuiFleet.
levels.aws_recipe: AWS Greengrass recipe documents are accepted, translated or rejected with stated semantics.

statuses.implemented: Merged and covered by cited local evidence.
statuses.partial: A cited subset is merged; the remainder is listed.
statuses.proposed: Specified here; implementation belongs to the listed tickets.
statuses.undecided: Requires a user/Codex scope decision before an implementation ticket is approved.
statuses.excluded: Out of scope by an explicit approved decision.
statuses.roadmap: Missing functional work tracked by the listed roadmap ticket (SF-064); neither specified here nor an approved exclusion.
statuses.not-applicable: The level has no meaning for this capability.

platforms.notes: Daemon and simulator/localnet runtime evidence on x86_64 development hosts.
Yocto QEMU aarch64 boot evidence; physical Raspberry Pi 3 B+ acceptance pending in SF-031.
Catalog selection vectors only; architecture.detail (arm61/arm71/arm81) is not represented and is rejected by translation.

i686 daemon, release bundle and native x86 catalog selection with 32-bit userland software-runner evidence; no 32-bit kernel or hardware. Outside the SF-038 initial Linux prototype phase; translated recipes still omit x86 manifests and report them.
No Windows runtime; outside the SF-038 initial Linux prototype phase and a tracked gap. Translated recipes omit Windows manifests.
Native macOS LaunchDaemon runtime and catalog OS `macos` (SF-075), tested on a hosted macOS 15 arm64 runner; not a Greengrass platform. Translated recipes still omit darwin manifests.

aws-recipe-cases.json.description: AWS recipe subset classification and expected native catalog manifests.
aws-recipe-cases.json.current_api_scope: The current daemon and frontend validators, including SF-014 lifecycle fields, reject every AWS-format recipe and accept every expected translated native recipe.

pubsub-cases.json.description: MQTT topic name/filter validity and matching, and AWS-compatible local pub/sub ACL resource matching.
pubsub-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's pub/sub module executes all 53 cases (make edge-test); scripts/test_messaging.py exercises the same rules through real IPC UIDs and a real Mosquitto broker.

shadow-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's shadow store executes all 54 steps of the 10 sequences, each also after reopening the store from disk (make edge-test); scripts/test_shadows.py exercises the same semantics through real IPC UIDs, restarts, kill -9 and a verifying reference cloud shadow service.

stream-cases.json.runtime_scope: The daemon's stream store executes all 5 sequences (make edge-test); scripts/test_streams.py exercises the same semantics through real IPC UIDs, crashes and a verifying export receiver.

client-device-cases.json.description: LAN client identity state and group/policy authorization.

managed-dependency-cases.json.description: SF-038 classification of AWS recipe dependencies on AWS-managed components against the managed catalog.

credential-provider-cases.json.description: SF-038 credential-provider (token exchange equivalent) grants, tokens, caching and upstream retry.
credential-provider-cases.json.notes: SF-057 ran all declared fixtures against the actual local Linux adapter and mTLS upstream. Live AWS acceptance remains unrun; see the scoped runtime receipt.

cloudwatch-metrics-cases.json.description: SF-038 cloudwatch-metrics-export adapter pinned to aws.greengrass.Cloudwatch 4.0.0: request validation, grants, batching, retention and retry.
cloudwatch-metrics-cases.json.notes: Runtime execution belongs to the cloudwatch-metrics-export implementation ticket SF-059. Reference-model agreement is not adapter execution.

cloudwatch-logs-cases.json.description: SF-038 cloudwatch-logs-export adapter pinned to aws.greengrass.LogManager 2.3.14: levels, redaction, group/stream names, batching, spool and checkpoint.
cloudwatch-logs-cases.json.notes: Runtime execution belongs to the cloudwatch-logs-export implementation ticket SF-060. Reference-model agreement is not adapter execution.

capabilities.notes: Native recipe 1.0/1.1 with one authenticated artifact, optional install and dependencies. AWS recipes are rejected today; SF-037 implements the translation subset.
Exact values and * only; amd64 maps to x86_64; regex, architecture.detail, runtime and custom keys are rejected.

Native comparator grammar only; npm x-ranges, hyphen ranges and || are rejected. AWS HARD/SOFT restart coupling is not implemented natively (a dependent is not stopped when a dependency fails); translation preserves the field.

Native install plus SF-014 supervised run/shutdown/readiness/restart. AWS run/shutdown translate with reported restart/timeout differences; bootstrap, startup, recover, uninstall, Timeout, Setenv, RequiresPrivilege and Skipif are rejected.
Nonempty configuration is rejected today. GetConfiguration/UpdateConfiguration-style access is part of the SF-027 local API.

capabilities.aws_reference: Greengrass IPC (event-stream over a local socket) and component SDKs
capabilities.notes: SF-027 defines the native authenticated local API. Reproducing the AWS IPC wire protocol and SDK compatibility needs a separate scope decision.
Deny by default; * glob resources; recipe accessControl is deferred until SF-027.
Native IPC operations with AWS-shaped policies; durable QoS 1 and bounded QoS 0. Not the AWS IPC wire protocol.

capabilities.aws_reference: Moquette/EMQX broker components for client devices
capabilities.notes: Standard MQTT 3.1.1/5 protocol conformance, not an AWS API.

LocalMqtt<->Pubsub routing is implemented over plain MQTT 3.1.1 to a local broker; TLS and client-device auth are SF-035; any cloud target (IotCore or another broker) is a selected adapter needing approval.

Native IPC operations with AWS ShadowManager-shaped policies and AWS-shaped local pub/sub notification topics; not the AWS IPC wire protocol. No per-key metadata timestamps; deletion keeps the version sequence.

capabilities.aws_reference: Shadow manager synchronization with AWS IoT Device Shadow
capabilities.notes: SF-033 implements a device-signed HTTP(S) compare-and-swap sync adapter with three-way merge and a per-section conflict owner, tested against a local reference service. AWS IoT Device Shadow synchronization is the aws-iot-core-connection adapter (SF-061). On-chain storage of shadow documents is not proposed.
Native IPC operations; per-message eviction and crash-skipped (never reused) numbering differ from AWS. Not the Stream Manager SDK wire protocol.

SF-034 implements signed, resumable HTTP(S) export with checkpoints. Kinesis Data Streams and S3 export is the stream-export-aws adapter (SF-058). SiteWise export is SF-064 roadmap work; IoT Analytics is discontinued.

capabilities.aws_reference: Greengrass cloud discovery API and IP detector
capabilities.notes: Native discovery returns broker endpoints and CA from an authenticated source; the AWS discovery REST API is not proposed by default.

SF-057 local Linux IoT credential adapter with separate platform-managed UIDs; live AWS and physical integration remain pending: unmodified AWS SDKs read AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI/AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN. Upstream uses a separately provisioned AWS X.509 identity, not the Sui signer or Seal identity.
Each component maps to a native equivalent, a scoped adapter (SF-057 to SF-063) or an SF-064 roadmap gap. Recipe dependencies on them stay rejected until SF-037 adopts the classification.

capabilities.aws_reference: aws.greengrass.lambda component type, LambdaManager 2.3.9, launcher, runtimes, legacy subscription router
capabilities.notes: Lambda invocation and subscriptions are SF-064 roadmap work. Meanwhile functions can be repackaged as generic native components, which is not Lambda compatibility; Lambda recipes and dependencies are rejected with guidance.

capabilities.aws_reference: variant.DLR 1.6.16, variant.TensorFlowLite 2.5.15, model stores, SageMaker AI Edge Manager (discontinued 2024-04-26)
capabilities.notes: Runtimes and models are native components with authenticated artifacts. Example-equivalent inference components are SF-064 roadmap work; Edge Manager is discontinued.
Native metrics in SF-019/SF-020. CloudWatch export is the cloudwatch-metrics-export adapter (SF-059); Device Defender device-side metrics are SF-062 over aws-iot-core-connection (SF-061).
Native log collection in SF-020; CloudWatch Logs upload is the cloudwatch-logs-export adapter (SF-060).

SSH daemon, firewall and service configuration stay platform-owned. The secure-tunneling adapter (SF-063) is an explicitly configured supervised destination proxy that coexists with them; the open-source SSM agent can be packaged as a native component.

capabilities.aws_reference: aws.greengrass.Modbus 2.1.11, IoT SiteWise OPC UA collector/publisher/processor, EdgeConnectorForKVS 1.0.5
capabilities.notes: Protocol collectors are native components over SF-032/SF-034. SiteWise and Kinesis Video functions are SF-064 roadmap work.
The control plane is Sui; AWS control-plane API emulation is not proposed (recommend exclusion, pending decision).
